Entries.Title: Jurassic World Rebirth
Entries.Description: Five years after the events of Jurassic World Dominion, covert operations expert Zora Bennett is contracted to lead a skilled team on a top-secret mission to secure genetic material from the world's three most massive dinosaurs. When Zora's operation intersects with a civilian family whose boating expedition was capsized, they all find themselves stranded on an island where they come face-to-face with a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.

Entries.Title: Saving Grace
Entries.Description: Anna, an elementary school teacher, discovers that her student Grace is a victim of abuse. Driven by maternal instinct, Anna abducts Grace to protect her and assumes the role of a mother. As they bond amid threats from the authorities and Grace's abusive mother, Anna confronts her painful past, realizing that she needs healing as much as Grace does.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Anna, an emotionally distant teacher, determinedly prepares for an opportunity abroad. However, an unexpected turn of events leads her to meet Grace, a young student suffering from abuse. As she grows closer to the young girl, Anna becomes torn between pursuing her dreams and saving Grace from her abusive parents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Anna rescues Grace and accompanies her to Quezon, but they face numerous setbacks along the way. The news of Grace's disappearance reaches public affairs host Miranda Valdez, who then shows interest in the story to save her program. Meanwhile, Chito gets questioned by the authorities about the possible abuse of the missing child.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Anna and Grace find refuge in Lucia's abandoned orphanage. While Anna works to provide for their needs, her past catches up with her when Miranda, Detective Oscar and TV producer Julius investigate her involvement in the missing girl's case. As the pressure of investigation mounts and Lucia's vindictive son looms eviction, Anna faces a heart-wrenching decision for Grace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tension rises when the police locate Lucia's orphanage and Sarah catches sight of her daughter, Grace. Luckily, Grace manages to escape while Sarah is left bewildered by her action. Left with no other option, Anna takes Grace to Palawan and seeks help from her adoptive mother, Helena. However, family tensions rise, threatening to expose Anna's secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: To protect Grace, Anna is forced to pretend that the former is her child and divert the police investigation away from her. However, Julius relentlessly asks questions who the child's father is, while Helena starts to doubt her supposed granddaughter's identity. Soon, a heated confrontation compels Anna to reveal her long-buried secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After discovering that Anna is hiding Grace, Julius forces them to surrender. However, an accident strands them in a deserted house where Anna and Grace reveal to Julius the whole truth behind their actions. Tensions escalate at the Sarmientos' inn as Miranda, Oscar, Sarah, and Chito become more suspicious of Anna compelling her to choose between Grace and her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Helena urges Anna to return Grace to her mother, while Sarah's persistent harassment causes an accident at the Sarmiento's inn. Julius helps Anna and Grace hide, but Jessica soon finds their shelter and gets incriminating evidence against Anna. Meanwhile, a stolen bracelet leads Miranda to uncover a shocking truth about someone she has been searching for over the years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After discovering Anna's past, an unjust manipulation of their interview compels Miranda to choose between helping Anna and protecting her career. A heated confrontation between Miranda and Helena causes past pains to resurface. Grace's and Anna's safety are put at risk when Princess makes a reckless decision and Julius' father discovers his involvement in the missing girl's case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Despite managing to escape Palawan with her help, Anna struggles to fully trust Miranda. Meanwhile, Miranda receives a startling news that makes her determined to set things right for Anna. While the television host works to clear Anna's name and exposes Sarah's true nature, Sarah finds someone's help to fight back Miranda, raising suspicions about who might be hiding Anna.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Helena is desperate to keep Anna away from Miranda, fearing that their growing bond will unravel her dark secrets. Anna, determined to flee with Grace, considers questionable means when their hideout gets discovered. Jessica's actions become more unpredictable, while Sarah's growing suspicions intensify the looming threat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As Oscar closes in on Grace and Anna, Erin's resurfacing memories reveal the root of Anna's painful past. Princess' betrayal prompts the Sarmientos to uncover a life-altering truth about Helena. In a selfless move, Miranda makes a sacrifice that will put her career and reputation in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Anna's world crumbles when she discovers a long-buried family secret. Miranda entrusts Grace with the key to her shared past with Anna and tries to protect her secret at all costs. However, a revenge-driven Sarah exposes a startling revelation that threatens to break Anna and Miranda's fragile bond.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Despite Miranda's struggle with her worsening condition, Anna finds it difficult to forgive her biological mother. However, a sudden discovery leads to Anna's change of heart. As everyone continues to search for Grace, the accused teacher faces harassment and serious charges in court—until an unexpected arrival seemingly changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Grace does everything she can to help Anna, only to hear that she has to stay in a shelter for her safety and well-being. Meanwhile, Sarah's anger fuels her relentless drive to win Grace back, leading her to make a desperate attempt to reclaim her daughter. As tensions escalate, Anna makes a bold and unexpected move to save Grace.

Entries.Title: SAKAMOTO DAYS
Entries.Description: Once the greatest hitman of all, Taro Sakamoto retired in the name of love. But when his past catches up, he must fight to protect his beloved family.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Hit Man
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.

Episodes.Title: Vs. Son Hee and Bacho
Episodes.Description: While out on an errand, Sakamoto and Shin encounter Lu Shaotang, the daughter of a mafia boss, who's on the run and targeted by twin assassins.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Sugar Park
Episodes.Description: After learning of the huge bounty on Sakamoto's head, the crew tries to enjoy a family outing at the amusement park while fending off assassins.

Episodes.Title: Hard-Boiled
Episodes.Description: With the poison-wielding hitman taken out, the Sakamotos head to their next attraction, where they're ambushed by Dondenkai Ltd's ultimate assassin duo.

Episodes.Title: Source of Strength
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto goes all out in a fierce one-on-one duel with Boiled. Meanwhile, ORDER members are tasked with handling a serial case targeting assassins.

Episodes.Title: Heisuke Mashimo
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win the million-yen prize, Team Sakamoto enters the shopping district's survival tournament and teams up with a completely clueless sniper.

Episodes.Title: Jurassic Bastard
Episodes.Description: While manning the store alone, Lu gets kidnapped by a mysterious group. Sakamoto and Shin pursue her but are halted by an invisible assassin.

Episodes.Title: Sakamoto's vs. the Lab
Episodes.Description: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, in the prison cell, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood.

Episodes.Title: All Aboard
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto engages in an intense battle against Kashima.

Episodes.Title: Bathhouse Roughhouse
Episodes.Description: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.

Episodes.Title: Casino Battle
Episodes.Description: The crew faces Wutang in a high-stakes casino showdown to learn who issued Sakamoto's bounty. Meanwhile, X sends a group of vicious assassins their way

Episodes.Title: Overload
Episodes.Description: As Sakamoto gathers intel on the assassins targeting him, ORDER begins hunting the death row inmates. Later, Shin and Lu face a deadly assault.

Episodes.Title: Just Desserts
Episodes.Description: Saw's attacks push Shin and Lu to awaken new abilities, turning the tables on the deadly killer. Meanwhile, Dump ambushes Osaragi at a temple.

Episodes.Title: Strong Assault
Episodes.Description: The battles rage on even as the crew gets treated by Granny Miya! Minimalist threatens Aoi at the store while Heisuke clashes with Apart at Tokyo Tower.

Episodes.Title: Round and Round the Tower
Episodes.Description: Deadly battles with death row inmates break out everywhere! The Minimalist who attacked the Sakamoto Store is defeated by Nagumo of ORDER, disguised as Aoi, leaving only Apart as the only death row inmate remaining.
